title: One Hour
audience: Young Ethiopians in their late teens to thirties who scroll on their phones most evenings; watching vertically on TikTok, Instagram or WhatsApp status.
intent: They should recognise their own late-night scrolling in Daniel, and finish the film feeling a gentle push to start one small thing today instead of waiting for the perfect time.
style: warm hand-painted cinematic illustration, soft film grain, muted teal shadows with amber highlights, 35mm look, no text or logos

characters.daniel: Daniel, an Ethiopian man in his mid-twenties, short curly black hair, light stubble, grey hoodie
characters.old_man: an elderly Ethiopian man with deep wrinkles and white stubble, worn brown wool cap, faded olive jacket, kind tired eyes

music.prompt: slow, warm, melancholic cinematic score, soft piano and low strings, gentle build to hope, instrumental

shots.reason: Open on the cold blue glow of the phone so the audience recognises their own evening before any story begins.
shots.image_prompt: night, small bedroom in Addis Ababa, the young man lying on his bed lit only by cold blue phone light, dark room, centered composition

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Every night, Daniel scrolled. Watches other people's cars, other people's house, Other people's adventures.
narration.delivery: in a calm, low, reflective voice

shots.reason: Show exactly what he consumes (luxury he compares himself to) so the viewer feels the pull and the emptiness of it.
shots.image_prompt: close up of a hand holding a glowing phone, the screen shows a blurred luxury car and a mansion, cold blue light on the thumb, dark background, centered composition

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: And every night, he made himself the same promise.
narration.delivery: in a calm, low, reflective voice

shots.reason: The promise itself: the shared lie of 'tomorrow' is the emotional hinge of the film and must be heard in his own voice.
shots.image_prompt: the young man in a dark bedroom, face half lit by phone light, tired eyes, a wall clock in the background showing nearly two in the morning, centered composition

shots.reason: Colour turns from cold blue to warm amber: the first sign that a different kind of light, and a different answer, is outside.
shots.image_prompt: dusk on a busy roadside in Addis Ababa, an old man roasting corn on a glowing charcoal brazier, warm amber light and drifting smoke, wide shot, centered composition

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: But tomorrow never came. One evening, he passed an old man roasting corn by the road.
narration.delivery: in a calm, low, reflective voice

shots.reason: The question the audience wants to ask themselves, asked by Daniel with curiosity rather than judgement.
shots.image_prompt: the young man standing next to the old man's charcoal brazier at dusk, speaking to him, warm amber glow on both faces, medium shot, centered composition

narration.speaker: daniel
narration.text: Grandpa, why are you still working so hard at your age?

shots.reason: The old man's regret is the film's emotional centre; a close face and a slow voice let the line land without decoration.
shots.image_prompt: close portrait of the old man smiling tiredly, glowing embers reflected in his eyes, warm amber light, shallow depth of field, centered composition

narration.speaker: old_man
narration.text: Because when I was young, I kept waiting for the perfect time. Now, I wish I could buy back just one hour of my youth.

shots.reason: The central metaphor (time as currency) is delivered over a simple gesture, a gift of corn, so an abstract idea becomes something you can see.
shots.image_prompt: weathered hands passing a roasted corn cob to the young man, glowing embers and smoke, warm amber light, close shot, centered composition

narration.speaker: old_man
narration.text: Time is the only currency you cannot earn back. You can lose money, and make it again.

shots.reason: The payoff: the cold blue returns as warm morning gold and Daniel acts, giving the viewer a concrete picture of 'start now'.
shots.image_prompt: the young man sitting at a small desk in a bedroom at sunrise, open laptop, golden morning light through the window, hopeful, centered composition

narration.speaker: old_man
narration.text: Don't wait for the perfect time. Start with the time you have.
